_note: The media stations of the platform and where their weights come from: Stable
Audio 3, ImageBind, MMAudio, HeartMuLa, Hunyuan3D 2 and the media readers
(the audio describer, the lyrics transcriber, the music taggers). ONE table,
the way config/local_llm_weights.json is one for the language models: the
installer (services/local_media_install) downloads from it, the ComfyUI
clients resolve an alias to a weights folder with it, the backend status of
the settings page reads it. Until stage 6 of
the move to ComfyUI the same knowledge stood in
gpu_service/config.py and in the backends of the GPU service.
'stations' names the folder under <ComfyUI>/models/ each station lists (the
node package registers the same name, comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/_card.py)
and the library the station imports. 'models' are the weights, keyed by the
platform's alias; 'station' says which folder, 'dir' the sub-folder the
weights are written to and the name the node lists. Whether that folder
holds a whole model is decided in the node package, once for both sides
(comfyui_nodes/ai4artsed_comfyui/_whole.py). 'kind' says how the installer fetches:
'snapshot' a Hugging Face repository (with 'ignore' patterns left out),
'files' single files of a repository, 'url' one file from a URL, 'parts'
several repositories into sub-folders. 'cached' names repositories the
library loads by name from the Hugging Face cache beside the weights; the
installer fetches them into that cache. size_gb is what the download
fetches, in GB, read off the files on 2026-09-14.
The reading block is the media-analysis station's own knowledge, moved
here from gpu_service/services/media_analysis_backend.py (struck 2026-10-10) letter for letter:
which reader answers which task ('local/' names an entry of
local_llm_weights.json), the prompts the readers are given, the vocabulary
the music taggers score, and whether the label embeddings are centered.
The stable_audio block is the tier policy of gpu_service/services/
stable_audio_model.py: one machine-local decision, medium on a card with
medium_min_vram_gb or more, else the small variant of the kind asked for;
env AI4ARTSED_STABLE_AUDIO_MODEL=medium|small overrides it
(services/stable_audio_tier).

hunyuan3d-2.also: rembg fetches its u2net.onnx (176 MB) into ~/.u2net on the first background removal

prompts.audio: Report only what is present in this audio. Name an instrument only if you can identify it; if you cannot, say so. Do not name a genre unless it is unambiguous. Do not describe the person of any speaker or singer. Do not fill gaps. If there is nothing, say there is nothing.
prompts.video: Report only what is present in this video, and when it happens. Name a thing only if you can identify it; if you cannot, say so. Do not describe the person of anyone visible. Do not fill gaps. If there is nothing, say there is nothing.
prompts.image: Report only what is present in this image. Name a thing only if you can identify it; if you cannot, say so. Do not describe the person of anyone visible. Do not fill gaps. If there is nothing, say there is nothing.

_prompts_note: The prompts ask for restraint on purpose; they were measured (2026-08-05,
four settings on two recordings, recorded in the GPU service's backend and
in docs/analysis), and the audio system prompt is part of the same setting:
changing one without the other changes the result. 'precisely' is the
working ingredient. No instruction to be comprehensive, rich or flowing,
and the model is never addressed as a listener or a viewer.
music_tag_vocabulary: a rough recording made in a room
_vocabulary_note: The label set is the platform's, not the model's: the taggers embed any
English string and score its cosine similarity against the recording, so
a result is always the best match within this list, never what the music
is, and there is no abstain. The strings are model inputs and stay
English. clap-music-speech is the reader; muq-mulan stays installed as a
center_label_embeddings subtracts the mean label embedding before scoring;
off, because it was measured to make every measure slightly worse.
